question: This is a topographic map of a real place (Bear Mountain, New York), drawn in the style of a USGS 7.5-minute quadrangle. The contour interval is 20 meters, index contours (heavy brown lines, some labeled) are every 100 meters, and elevations are in meters. Rescue carry: a stretcher team carries a casualty along the Pack Trail (dashed red line) from the magenta square S to the magenta square E. To pace the carry, the team leader logs every contour line the trail crosses. How many contour lines (index contours included) does the trail cross between S and E? If it crosses the same contour line more than once, count every crossing. Answer with a whole number, for example 7.
references: USGS 7.5-minute topographic quadrangle maps (US Topo, 1:24 000): brown contours, heavy index contours
Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP, public domain) via AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (terrarium, zoom 13)
